name: Collin Chartier
summary: Tested positive for EPO in a 2023 out-of-competition test and accepted a three-year ban.

name: Yuliya Yelistratova
summary: Anti-doping rule violation (presence and use of EPO); banned for five years.

name: Adnan Zaki
summary: Anti-doping rule violation (adverse analytical finding); banned for two years.

name: Baqer Taher Idrees
summary: Anti-doping rule violation (presence and use); banned for two years.

name: Pedro Afonso Gaspar
summary: Anti-doping rule violation (presence and use of mesterolone); banned for three years.

name: Igor Polyanskiy
summary: Tested positive for EPO in a July 2021 out-of-competition test and received a three-year ban; results including Tokyo 2020 were disqualified.

name: Nina Kraft
summary: Tested positive for EPO after winning the 2004 Ironman World Championship; admitted use and was stripped of the title and banned.

name: Brigitte McMahon
summary: Tested positive for EPO in a 2005 out-of-competition test and received a two-year ban; the case ended her career.

name: Dmitriy Gaag
summary: Tested positive for EPO in a 2008 out-of-competition test and received a two-year ban.

name: Virginia Berasategui
summary: Tested positive for EPO after winning the 2013 Bilbao Triathlon and admitted the violation.

name: Michael Weiss
summary: Received a two-year ban in 2011 after Austria's anti-doping agency found he had used a blood-doping laboratory.

name: Tim Don
summary: Served a three-month suspension in 2006 for three missed out-of-competition tests (a whereabouts violation - not a positive test).

name: Hongni Wang
summary: Tested positive for testosterone metabolites in a 2007 out-of-competition test and served a two-year ban.

name: Lisa Marangon
summary: Tested positive for ostarine at the 2016 Challenge Melbourne and received a four-year ban; she denied intentional use.

name: Mariana Ohata
summary: Tested positive for the masking agent furosemide in 2009 and received a six-year ban as a second offence.
